note: 'error bars medimu thickness': 'thickness' is the head of a nominal that also holds 'error bars', so the bars are folded into the value instead of being told it.
sop:
@n1 syntax.nominal dependent="error" head="bars"
@c1 syntax.clause form=fragment modifier="medimu" modifier="thickness" complement=$n1

note: 'the missing piece: line magenta on the profit chart': 'magenta' is the head of the nominal that also holds 'line', so the colour becomes the head of the thing it is said of.
'slice explosion medium again': 'medium' is the head of the nominal that also holds 'slice explosion', so the word that says how the slices should be becomes the thing meant.
sop:
@n1 syntax.nominal dependent="slice" head="explosion"
@c1 syntax.clause form=fragment modifier="medium" modifier="again" complement=$n1

note: 'and also Headcount by department: slice gaps maximum': 'maximum' is a dependent of 'slice gaps', so the word that says how the gaps should be describes which gaps are meant.
'one arrangement: chart low, image above': 'low' and 'above' are held as dependents of 'chart' and 'image', so the words that say where each should stand describe which chart and image are meant.
'chart AVG(claim cost) by region': 'AVG(claim' and 'cost' stand as two complements of 'chart', so the measure that 'AVG' takes is split away from it.
'chart AVG(cllaim cost) by region': 'AVG(cllaim' and 'cost' stand as two complements of 'chart', so the measure that 'AVG' takes is split away from it.
'the count support tickets' is written as one nominal with 'tickets' as its head and 'count' a dependent, so the count that is asked for becomes a description of the tickets.
sop:
@n1 syntax.nominal dependent="the" head="count" dependent="support" dependent="tickets"
@c1 syntax.clause form=fragment complement=$n1
